name: Grade 9 IT Practice: May Week 10 - Project Build
description: Practice words for Grade 9 first-trimester physical computing work.

words.definition: One smaller part of a larger system.
words.example: The sensor subsystem collected input before the LED subsystem responded.
The team checked the wiring after the buzzer did not sound.

words.definition: The rules and order used in code.
words.example: The code logic turned the warning light on only when the sensor value was low.

words.definition: Notes or records that explain work.
words.example: The documentation included a photo of the circuit and notes about the code.
The test result showed that the LED worked but the buzzer was too quiet.

words.definition: To isolate and fix a problem in one project subsystem before retesting the whole build.
words.example: The group can debug the project by testing one subsystem at a time.
